buildings.Bridge.name: Bridge
buildings.Bridge.description: The old bridge over the river. Fix it up, and the villagers will start leaving you requests.
buildings.Bridge.story.0.text: The bridge is standing again! Can you hear that? The villagers are coming back home.
buildings.Bridge.story.1.text: Every day they'll pin requests on the board in the square. Do what they ask, and they'll give you stars. You'll need stars for the next buildings in the village.
buildings.Mill.name: Water mill
buildings.Mill.description: The water mill grinds wheat into flour. Once it's fixed, you can build a mill right on your farm.
buildings.Mill.story.0.text: The mill wheel is turning again! The miller is so grateful that he taught you how to build a mill right on your farm.
buildings.Mill.story.1.text: build(Machines.Mill) builds a mill under the drone (it costs wood). make(Goods.Flour) grinds 20 wheat into flour at the mill in a few seconds.
buildings.Mill.story.2.text: When the flour is ready, isRipe() returns true and gather() picks it up. Now think: how can your code keep the mill from ever sitting idle?
buildings.JamHouse.name: Jam house
buildings.JamHouse.description: This is where eggplant gets cooked into jam. Unlocks the jam pot.
buildings.JamHouse.story.0.text: The jam house is open! Grandma Anahit gave you her secret recipe
buildings.JamHouse.story.1.text: Put a jam pot on your farm with build(Machines.JamPot). make(Goods.Jam) cooks 10 eggplants and 1 water into jam. The bakery will need that jam.
buildings.Bakery.name: Bakery
buildings.Bakery.description: A bakery with a tonir (a clay oven in the ground) for lavash, gata, ghapama and grilled fish. Unlocks the tonir and eating.
buildings.Bakery.story.0.text: The bakery fire is lit, and the smell of warm lavash is coming from the tonir again
buildings.Bakery.story.1.text: Build a tonir with build(Machines.Tonir). In it you can bake lavash (thin Armenian flatbread), gata (a sweet Armenian pastry) and ghapama (a stuffed pumpkin dish, but here we use watermelon!), and you can grill fish too. The recipes are in the village, next to the "Bakery".
buildings.Bakery.story.2.text: And you can eat what you bake: eat(Goods.Gata). Gata makes the drone 2 times faster for 30 seconds, ghapama makes plants grow fast, and grilled fish brings you goldfish luck.
buildings.Bakery.story.3.text: Quick question: when is the best time to eat gata?
buildings.Bakery.story.3.quiz.answers.0: When the drone has lots of work to do
buildings.Bakery.story.3.quiz.right: Right! The speed boost only lasts 30 seconds, so eat it when the drone has lots of work.
buildings.Bakery.story.3.quiz.wrong: Not quite. If the code is stopped, the boost runs out for nothing. Try again.
buildings.Greenhouse.name: Greenhouse
buildings.Greenhouse.description: A glass house where winter never comes. Unlocks glass tiles on your farm.
buildings.Greenhouse.story.0.text: The greenhouse is sparkling in the sun. Now even winter can't scare us!
buildings.Greenhouse.story.1.text: greenhouse() covers the tile under the drone with glass. Under glass it's always the plant's favorite season, and rain, heat, frost and lightning can't get in. So you have to do the watering yourself.
buildings.Greenhouse.story.2.text: The glass stays forever. Think about which tiles of your farm are worth covering.
buildings.School.name: School
buildings.School.description: Every week there's a coding challenge here, on the same test farm for everyone. Whoever solves it fastest goes to the top of the list.
buildings.School.story.0.text: The school is open again! Do you hear the bell?
buildings.School.story.1.text: There'll be a new challenge here every week. Everyone solves the same task on the same test farm, so it's totally fair: whoever solves it fastest wins.
buildings.School.story.2.text: Open the School in the village and press "Start challenge". You'll write your code on a new, clean page, and your farm will wait for you in the meantime.
buildings.Square.name: Festival square
buildings.Square.description: This is where the village celebrates Armenian holidays. On festival days, objects are hidden on your farm, and whoever finds them gets the festival hat.
buildings.Square.story.0.text: The festival square is decorated again. The fountain is running and the flags are waving.
buildings.Square.story.1.text: Now the village will celebrate Armenian holidays: Trndez, Easter, Vardavar, Navasard and more. On festival days, objects are hidden on your farm. sniff() tells you how many steps it is to the nearest one, and dig() digs it up.
buildings.Square.story.2.text: But careful: if you dig in the wrong spot, the object runs off somewhere else. Work it out first, then dig. And whoever finds lots of them gets the festival hat.
intro.0.text: On the other side of the river there's an old village. Once upon a time its water mill turned, the tonir smelled of fresh lavash, and children played in the square.
intro.1.text: But one spring a storm broke the bridge, and everyone left the village. The houses fell apart, and the mill stopped turning.
intro.2.text: I think together we can bring the village back to life. Let's start with the bridge. For each building, bring whatever you have with the "Give" button. A little at a time is fine.
finale.0.text: Hooray! The village is alive again! The mill is turning, the bakery fire is lit, and flowers grow in the greenhouse even in winter.
finale.1.text: The villagers chose you as their mayor! Your new hat is the "Mayor hat": wearHat(Hats.Mayor). And now you can spend your stars on boosts at the request board.
requests.villagers.0.name: Erik
requests.villagers.0.lines.0: Soccer makes me SO hungry. Could you bring me some {item}? {amount} would be great.
requests.villagers.0.lines.1: I want to treat my friends. Got some {item} for me? I need {amount}.
requests.villagers.1.name: Nshan
requests.villagers.1.lines.0: I've got a new project for the village. I need some {item}. {amount} should do it.
requests.villagers.1.lines.1: We're fixing up the village one step at a time. Can you help with some {item}? {amount}, please.
requests.villagers.2.name: Grandma Anahit
requests.villagers.2.lines.0: My grandkids are coming over! I need some {item} to cook them something tasty. {amount} would be just right.
requests.villagers.2.lines.1: Oh, my hands aren't what they used to be. Could you bring me some {item}, sweetie? {amount}, if you can.
requests.villagers.3.name: Siranush the baker
requests.villagers.3.lines.0: The bakery is waiting! I need some {item}. {amount}, please.
requests.villagers.3.lines.1: There's a festival tomorrow and I'm so busy! Please bring me some {item}. {amount} will do.
requests.villagers.4.name: Aram the fisherman
requests.villagers.4.lines.0: We're having a picnic by the lake. I need some {item}. {amount} should be enough.
requests.villagers.4.lines.1: I'm fixing my boat. Could you bring me some {item}? I need {amount}.
requests.villagers.5.name: Little Lilit
requests.villagers.5.lines.0: We have a project at school! I need some {item}. {amount}, please!
requests.villagers.5.lines.1: I want to surprise my mom! Can you help me with some {item}? I need {amount}.
